quest.title: The Homebound Moon
quest.description: Columbina is having a spot of trouble in the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it just Paimon, or do you smell something yummy too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Columbina's having a feast for one!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like someone's enjoying herself...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Would you like to try some as well?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, no, you go ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We don't usually see you eating here! Did you go out just to buy it?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Lauma gave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, she sure takes good care of you, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: On the condition that I don't leave.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what!? Isn't that just a bribe so you'll accept house arrest? And a cheap one, at that!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: She also brought me some interesting books and exquisitely made toys...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, now it sounds more like a mother going out on a business trip and the kid she's leaving at home...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did Lauma explain her reasoning?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: She just told me not to go out for the time being, and to be especially sure to avoid the Frostmoon Scions.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I asked the animals who came to deliver my meals, but Lauma had instructed them to remain silent, and so they did.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, that's...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: If I had to guess, she is preparing something that has to do with me.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Worry not. I have never considered staying here boring in the first place. The food is good, and much to my liking. Not going out is fine with me.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: And if the Scions are indeed preparing for something... Well, all the more reason not to interrupt them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Want us to go ask around?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Paimon's kinda curious now, too.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: You can... but you should be prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: She likely knows you'll come to see me, so she may not tell you anything at all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You wanna renovate the statue of Kuutar!?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Precisely so.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: No longer is she the wingless Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar who could only gaze at the moon beyond the skies in solitude.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: We witnessed her unfurling her wings, and know she has regained the freedom to live.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: As such, it is only right that the statue, too, be restored.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That does sound like a good idea!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you told the other Frostmoon Scions about this?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: That I have. I spoke to them of the Moon Goddess's sacrifice, and her return...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: And of how we stood against the force that pollutes this world with the guidance of that gentle light.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Everyone was delighted to hear of her return, so I took the opportunity to convey Columbina's thoughts to them...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: That she wants to see us as family, and would like us to do the same for her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what did everyone say?

dialogues.speaker: Zirnytsia
dialogues.text: The Lady Moon Goddess...

dialogues.speaker: Lauha
dialogues.text: Would we... not be overstepping by regarding her as family?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I believe that this is what Columbina genuinely wishes for.

dialogues.speaker: Kunegunda
dialogues.text: (I can't believe the Lady Moonchanter referred to our Moon Goddess by her first name!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Perhaps you may all yet recall the words I spoke not long ago.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: "The road shall be paved with truth, and we shall pave it ourselves."

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I will not ask all of you to make the same choice as I, but I do have words I would like to share with you this day.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: "If we wish to invite the moonlight in to stay, we must first open doors that once were tightly shut."

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...That is what happened. Considering the situation over the past few days, things seem to have gone better than I thought they might have.

dialogues.speaker: Maciej
dialogues.text: Lady Lauma. A new batch of stone has arrived at the warehouse.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Understood. I'll be right over.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Could you keep what I said, including what you've seen, a secret from Columbina — at least for now? I'd like this to be a surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon knows you mean well, but seriously, you sure do love your surprises... You, and your Moon Goddess...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: My lips are sealed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Lauma, about Paimon's hush money... Er, Paimon meant to say, we don't happen to have any spare Feast of the Moon servings today, do we?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: That we do. Come, let me prepare some for you. Oh, and one more thing...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Ah, you're back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess what, Columbina? You were right, Lauma didn't tell us a thing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She seems quite busy, though.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So we'll be keeping you company over the next few days. You just sit tight and keep those expectations high!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Expectations for... what exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ack...! Oh! Uh, nothing! We don't know a thing, honest!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hehe... Very well, then. I look forward to spending the next few days with you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, here comes our food... Wait a minute. Where's the grub?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: It says, "The time has come." Do you know what that means?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohhhhh, Paimon gets it now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Columbina.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You usually wear a blindfold, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes. What of it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But you can use kuuvahki to observe the outside world even so, right?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: That's right. If anything, I sense things more clearly this way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then, uh, could we ask you to deliberately not sense any changes outside for the time being?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: So that this can be a "pleasant surprise"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Sounds like you've already guessed what this is about...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Alright. I see. In that case, would you take my hand?

talks.objective: Head to the statue of Kuutar

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here we are.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can open your eyes now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (She really did open her eyes!)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I just said that without thinking...)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: It's beautiful...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: This pair of wings makes it look all the more complete.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: This is a gift we Frostmoon Scions would like to give you, Columbina.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: To celebrate our goddess who can now fly free, whose fingers can at last touch the place she calls "home."

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: ...The me from before would only be reminded of the confusion I felt upon being born whenever I looked upon this statue.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: But now, what I feel is the warmth of a "home."

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Perhaps, like this statue, I have chosen to stay here even though I now have wings.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: ...Thank you all.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: We do have another gift prepared, but you'll have to walk with me a bit farther.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? There's another surprise?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: My fellow Scions and I have organized a simple welcome banquet in the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: From now on, this will be your home as well, Columbina.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Whenever you grow homesick, please, feel free to remain here and enjoy our hospitality, meager though it may be.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Sure. I will.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, what do you know? The moon's up.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Let's go, then.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: It is my hope that every night may be as wonderful as that Moon-Prayer Night.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Welcome home, Columbina.
